verdict.rationale: Adyen documents its own payout capability: managed payouts using its 'most efficient payout logic', payout schedules scoped to balance accounts of a given location and currency, and payouts to global sellers. Together these imply currency- and location-aware payouts. However, FX handling and settlement over local bank rails versus wires are never described. Missing for 10: documented FX conversion handling, explicit local bank rail settlement (vs wires), explicit local-currency payout support, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, international sellers get paid properly — local-currency payouts, documented FX handling, and settlement to local bank rails rather than expensive wires

citations.quote: you can create a managed payout schedule for your balance platform and apply it to balance accounts with the same location and currency
Managed payouts allow you to automate fund payouts to users on your balance platform using Adyen's most efficient payout logic.
Onboard global sellers with one integration while Adyen handles verification and payouts.
